QUICKWALLS.Title: Quick Walls
QUICKWALLS.BuildingHint: Rectangle tool — drag a box over a building
QUICKWALLS.RoundHint: Ellipse tool — drag an oval/circle over a round building
QUICKWALLS.FreehandHint: Freehand tool — trace a curved or irregular wall
QUICKWALLS.DoorHint: Freehand tool (auto-colored) — drag a line along a wall
QUICKWALLS.WindowHint: Freehand tool (auto-colored) — drag a line along a wall
QUICKWALLS.LightHint: Freehand tool (auto-colored) — click a mark where a light goes
QUICKWALLS.WallTypeHint: Which wall type you are drawing. Each type gets its own guide color, so you can mix types in one session and Build gives each stroke the type it was drawn as.
QUICKWALLS.BuildHint: Turn the drawings into walls, doors, windows, and lights
QUICKWALLS.CleanHint: Remove zero-length and duplicate walls from this scene
QUICKWALLS.CleanConfirm: Remove these walls? This cannot be undone.
QUICKWALLS.CleanNone: Quick Walls: no zero-length or duplicate walls found.
QUICKWALLS.ConfirmDelete: Create these walls and remove the guide drawings?
QUICKWALLS.NoBuildings: Quick Walls: no rectangle (building) drawings to wall yet.
QUICKWALLS.NoMatch: Quick Walls: no building rectangles, and the door/window lines aren't sitting on any wall to cut.
QUICKWALLS.Done: Quick Walls: built {walls} walls ({doors} doors, {windows} windows).
QUICKWALLS.Settings.DoorColor.Name: Door line color
QUICKWALLS.Settings.DoorColor.Hint: The color Quick Walls paints a line to mark a door. Lines of this color become doors.
QUICKWALLS.Settings.WindowColor.Name: Window line color
QUICKWALLS.Settings.WindowColor.Hint: The color Quick Walls paints a line to mark a window. Lines of this color become windows (block movement, let sight and light through).
QUICKWALLS.Settings.DeleteGuides.Name: Delete guide drawings after building
QUICKWALLS.Settings.DeleteGuides.Hint: Remove the rectangle and line drawings once their walls have been created.
QUICKWALLS.Settings.WindowSound.Name: Windows block sound
QUICKWALLS.Settings.WindowSound.Hint: When on, windows block sound (like glass). When off, sound passes through windows.
QUICKWALLS.Settings.LightColor.Name: Light mark color
QUICKWALLS.Settings.LightColor.Hint: The color Quick Walls paints a mark to place a light. Marks of this color become ambient lights.
QUICKWALLS.Settings.LightTint.Name: Light tint
QUICKWALLS.Settings.LightTint.Hint: The color of the ambient light that is placed (a warm tint reads as torch or candle light).
QUICKWALLS.Settings.LightBright.Name: Light bright radius
QUICKWALLS.Settings.LightBright.Hint: Bright-light radius of each placed light, in the scene's distance units (e.g. feet).
QUICKWALLS.Settings.LightDim.Name: Light dim radius
QUICKWALLS.Settings.LightDim.Hint: Dim-light radius of each placed light, in the scene's distance units (e.g. feet).
QUICKWALLS.Settings.LightTorch.Name: Lights flicker (torch)
QUICKWALLS.Settings.LightTorch.Hint: When on, placed lights use the torch flicker animation. When off, they are steady.
QUICKWALLS.Settings.WallColor.Name: Normal wall guide color
QUICKWALLS.Settings.WallColor.Hint: The guide color for Normal walls (rectangles, ellipses, and freehand strokes). Door and window lines stand out against it.
QUICKWALLS.Settings.TerrainColor.Name: Terrain wall guide color
QUICKWALLS.Settings.TerrainColor.Hint: The guide color for Terrain walls. Strokes of this color build as Terrain walls (limited sight and light).
QUICKWALLS.Settings.InvisibleColor.Name: Invisible wall guide color
QUICKWALLS.Settings.InvisibleColor.Hint: The guide color for Invisible walls. Strokes of this color build as Invisible walls (block movement only).
QUICKWALLS.Settings.EtherealColor.Name: Ethereal wall guide color
QUICKWALLS.Settings.EtherealColor.Hint: The guide color for Ethereal walls. Strokes of this color build as Ethereal walls (block sight, light, and sound; allow movement).
QUICKWALLS.Settings.WallSimplify.Name: Freehand wall smoothing
QUICKWALLS.Settings.WallSimplify.Hint: How much to simplify a traced freehand wall, as a fraction of a grid square. Higher is smoother with fewer segments; lower follows the curve more closely.
